title: Add AGENTS.md for Cursor Cloud development environment
body: ## Summary Adds `AGENTS.md` with Cursor Cloud-specific development instructions for future cloud agent sessions. ## What's included - Overview of the Spring PetClinic application stack (Spring Boot 4.0.3, Thymeleaf, H2) - Commands for running the app, tests, and lint checks - Key gotchas discovered during setup (format auto-fix, Docker requirement for MySQL tests, Playwright reuse config, hot-reload limitations) ## Environment verification The development environment was fully set up and verified: - **Java 21** + **Maven 3.9.12** (via wrapper) — builds cleanly - **Node.js 22** + **Playwright** — all 29 E2E tests pass - **Spring Boot app** runs on port 8080 with default H2 database - **Lint/Checkstyle** passes with 0 violations - **Unit tests** — 57 tests, 0 failures (2 skipped for Docker-dependent MySQL tests) ### Demo Created a new owner "Cursor Agent" and added pet "Buddy" (dog) to verify full CRUD flow. ![Owner Cursor Agent created](https://cursor.com/artifacts/c/art-7b7465d5-3d36-441e-b854-e0aa8e9d9cfa) ![Pet Buddy added to owner](https://cursor.com/artifacts/c/art-4f16f3ae-dc7f-4f5c-919a-865eca44b0b7)
